text: Once the safety plan is made with the professional, keep it easy to reach and, at a calm time, practise using it with your teen and contacting trusted people. Review it as things change; keep dangerous means away. In immediate danger, stay with them and call emergency services.

translation.manual_fix_note: Rewritten 2026-10-04 with the Arabic: the Saudi-only 937 line replaced by country-neutral emergency guidance, and the card is made with the child.
